question: Which of the following molecules has triangular plane geometry?
analysis: The molecule with triangular plane geometry is BF3. This is because BF3 has a trigonal planar shape due to the presence of three bonding pairs and no lone pairs on the central boron atom, resulting in a 120-degree bond angle. In contrast, NH3, AsH3, and XeO3 have pyramidal geometries due to the presence of lone pairs, and ClF3 has a T-shaped geometry.
